summary_1line: Ashtavakra resists a woman's advances, proving his self-restraint; she reveals the encounter was a divine test arranged by his future father-in-law.

image_candidates.scene_text: A beautiful maiden bows before the ascetic Ashtavakra, pleading for his love while he stands firm in austere restraint.
The mysterious woman reveals her radiant divine form as the embodiment of the northern direction after testing Ashtavakra.
Ashtavakra with folded hands respectfully takes leave of the goddess in the northern mountains after passing her test.
